name: Financial Tool Kit
description: A ledger-styled personal-finance toolkit (formerly Mortgage Tool Kit). Radial hub of tool areas: Mortgage is live (escrow analysis, amortization, PITI payment, affordability/DTI, refinance, compare, ARM, rent-vs-buy, T-Note lookup); Auto, Investing, Budgeting & Savings, Credit & Debt, and Retirement & Taxes are on the roadmap. Every area shows a forced 'information only, not advice' disclaimer.
